{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # A solid vertical separator marks two binary-pattern panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] != 0 for row in grid)), None)
    if sep is None:
        raise ValueError("no vertical separator")
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    if len(left[0]) != len(right[0]):
        raise ValueError("panels have different widths")
    return [[2 if left[r][c] and right[r][c] else 0
             for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(h)]
